Download the application form from the official website: www.apcob.bank.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the APCOB Faculty recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Andhra Pradesh State Cooperative Bank (APCOB) for hiring qualified faculty members on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under APCOB Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Faculty post in this recruitment drive at the APCOB Cooperative Training Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled-out offline application form along with the required documents and fee is 07-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for APCOB Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess Graduation with CAIIB/ Diploma in Cooperative Business Management (or) Post graduate in Commerce/MBA/Agriculture or related subjects with relevant teaching and banking experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for APCOB Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 35 and 62 years of age as on the date of the notification to be eligible to apply for this position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for APCOB Faculty positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs.70,000/- per month plus an additional Conveyance of Rs.5,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for APCOB Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs.1000/- via Demand Draft or NEFT/IMPS/UPI as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Interested candidates must send hard copies of their applications to the designated address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for APCOB Faculty jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process involves preliminary screening and short-listing based on qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form directly from the official website of APCOB at www.apcob.bank.in.
